**Now demonstrated, and the severity in the description above is understated.** Repro built on the existing `approval-revise.test.ts` harness (real engine + real `ApprovalService`), run against `main` @ `93f267f81`.

### Confirmed: unauthorized resubmit, no audit row

A raw `resume(runId)` on a run parked at the revise-window `wait`:

```
code:            undefined          ← not refused; `wait` is resumeAuthority 'any'
round-2 request: opened (new id)    ← the back-edge fired, the approval node re-entered
audit trail:     ['submit', 'revise']   ← no 'resubmit' row, ever
```

Two corrections to the description: it needs **no `branchLabel`** (an empty body works — the labelled back-edge is walked either way, verified both ways), and it bypasses `resubmit`'s **submitter-only** check as well as the audit row.

### Not in the description: it can permanently kill the run

`ApprovalService.resubmit` refuses with `DUPLICATE_REQUEST` when another request is already pending on the same record, and the code comment says exactly why:

> A colliding pending request on the same record … would make the approval node's re-entry fail AFTER the engine consumed the suspension — permanently killing the run. Refuse up front instead.

That guard lives in the service, and the raw resume goes around it:

```
service.resubmit(...)   → throws DUPLICATE_REQUEST, run still suspended (1)
automation.resume(runId) → { success: false,
                             error: "Node 'review' failed: … DUPLICATE_REQUEST: a pending
                                     approval already exists for fin_expense/x1" }
                           suspended runs: 0        ← consumed, run terminally dead
```

The approval is then unresolvable: the round-1 request stays `returned`, the run that owned it is gone, and no resubmit can ever reach it. Opportunistic (it needs a colliding pending request to exist, which an ordinary user can often cause — a record-change trigger re-firing inside the revise window is the documented case), but it is remote run destruction, not just a missing audit row.

### This changes the recommended fix

The description sketches a **per-suspension owner claim**. Having looked harder, the simpler option is the one [ADR-0044](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0044-approval-send-back-for-revision.md) considered and rejected — *"Approval node re-suspends itself in a 'revise mode' (no wait node)"* — or an equivalent dedicated node type. Either makes the revise pause **typed as service-owned**, so the existing `resumeAuthority` gate covers it with no new machinery. ADR-0044 chose the generic `wait` for reuse; what we know now is that a generic node sitting in a service-owned position is exactly what a type-keyed gate cannot see.

The owner-claim design is still the more general answer, but it needs care the sketch didn't account for: an approval whose `approve` branch leads to a `screen` must NOT inherit the claim, or the UI can no longer advance that screen. Blanket inheritance breaks screen flows downstream of an approval.

Refs #3801, #3853, #3879.

## 背景

#3822 已为 resume 端点建立**按节点类型**的门(`resumeAuthority`),approval 暂停已受保护。本单指出 ADR-0044 的 revise window 停在一个**普通 `wait` 节点**上,类型门天然看不见它;2026-07-28 的实证评论把严重度抬了一级:raw resume 不仅绕过 submitter-only 与审计行,在存在碰撞 pending request 时会**在引擎消费掉 suspension 之后失败,永久杀死 run**(审批不可再解)。缺陷真实、已实证,不是观察级。

## 要拍板什么

让 revise 暂停变成 service-owned 的机制,两案分叉在契约形状上:

**方案 A:专用 typed 暂停**(approval 节点以 revise 模式自挂起,或专用节点类型)——现有 `resumeAuthority` 类型门直接覆盖,零新机制。但这正是 ADR-0044 §Alternatives **考虑过并拒绝**的形状(当时理由:复用已有的 durable wait)。采纳 = 推翻一处已裁决的 ADR 备选,须维护者确认。

**方案 B:per-suspension owner claim**(驱动 run 进 wait 的服务持有唤出权,持久化在 suspension 上)——更通用,类型门退化为无 claim 时的默认。但实证评论指出了继承陷阱:approval 的 approve 分支通向 `screen` 时**不得**继承 claim,否则 UI 无法推进 screen —— 规则隐性,机制面更宽。

## 三轴分析

- **实际业务需求**:revise window 是 ADR-0044 已发布、审批流实际在用的能力;本单是把它的信任边界补完整,属核心能力正确性,不是能力扩张。已实证的 run destruction 是真实损害面。
- **项目长远合理性**:A 让「服务拥有的暂停」在类型系统里显式存在,与 #3822 的既有门复用,契约面收敛;B 引入跨节点新机制,当下只有一个消费者,通用性是预支的。
- **防 AI 写元数据犯错**:A 是 declared = enforced 的直接形状 —— 节点类型即权限,flow 作者(人或 AI)无法误配;B 的 claim 继承例外规则恰是 AI 最易写错、且错了静默的那类隐性知识。

## 建议

**方案 A**,三轴同向;因涉及推翻 ADR-0044 的一处已拒绝备选,按升级门槛交维护者拍板,不代答。拍板后本单摘标签回队列,可直接派发。

**维护者裁决(2026-08-05,经 services 车道 PM 转达):批准方案 A** —— revise 暂停改为 **typed / service-owned**(approval 节点以 revise 模式自挂起,或专用节点类型 —— 实施者按代码现状定形,两者等价于「类型门可见」),使 #3822 的既有 `resumeAuthority` 门直接覆盖,零新机制。ADR-0044 §Alternatives 中被拒绝的该备选由本裁决显式推翻 —— 实施 PR 须附 ADR-0044 的 amendment 段落记录这次改判及其依据(2026-07-28 实证评论:raw resume 可绕过 submitter-only/审计并在碰撞 pending request 下永久杀死 run)。

摘 `needs-user-decision`,回 `pm:queue`。排程:service-automation 包串行链 —— #5529(在飞)落地后,本单**优先于** #5048/#4792 派发(已实证的 run destruction > 日志格式/装配强制)。

实施注意(from 实证评论,派发时会写进派发词):
- owner-claim 方案已否 —— 尤其它的 screen 继承陷阱;
- revise 模式的 typed 暂停不得影响 approve 分支通向 `screen` 的既有 UI 推进;
- 复现 harness 已有(`approval-revise.test.ts` + 实证评论的三段实录),反向验证以它为基。
